title: Bins of +3, +2 and -9994 show the net -9989, not 5, in Inventory Value
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Reports View. API replays from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Data: QAPL-N5, tracked and active at Staging Heavy Duty, with bins +3, +2 and -9994. No category, vendor or search filter on the report.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory > open QAPL-N5; note its Average Cost {c} and its bins; Cancel.
  2. Reports > Inventory Value (/reports/inventory-value): location Staging Heavy Duty, As-of today > Run; find the QAPL-N5 row.
  3. Replay GET /api/reporting/reports/inventory-value for the same location and date; find QAPL-N5 in the response.
  4. Read the totals row (row_iv_totals).
  5. Export (button_iv_export) > CSV; open the file and sum its Total Cost column.
  6. Export (button_iv_export) > PDF; open the file.
custom_expected:
1. Bins +3, +2 and -9994; Average Cost {c} noted.
  2. QAPL-N5 is listed with Qty -9,989 shown in parentheses as (9,989), not 5; Total Cost = 9,989 × {c}, in parentheses; its own Margin % shows "—".
  3. 200; the QAPL-N5 row has qty -9989 and a negative total cost matching the screen.
  4. The totals include QAPL-N5's negative Total Cost, so the Total Cost total is lower by 9,989 × {c} than the sum of the other rows.
  5. The CSV has the same rows and totals as the screen; QAPL-N5 reads -9989 with the same negative Total Cost; the column sum equals the totals row.
  6. The PDF shows the same QAPL-N5 row and the same totals as the screen.
